Title: Q: timing on Blood Brother Ambush with Freak Drive (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Bioreset
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ!

1. Can you play superior Freak Drive after you play Blood Brother
Ambush and before combat with BBA?
2. Can you play Freak Drive after combat with BBA?

Example:

Armin Brenner bleeds and was blocked. I choose to play BBA . Can I
play superior Freak Drive before combat starts with BBA? Can I play
superior Freak Drive even after the combat with BBA ends and it is
burned.

Same thing with Conscripted Statue and Freak Drive? I try to search
answer, but didn't find any.

Blood Brother Ambush
Action Modifier
Brujah antitribu
Only usable when an action is blocked.
Combat does not occur. Put this card into play. While in play, this
card represents an ally with 3 life and 2 strength who can strike for
2R damage; this ally enters combat with the blocking minion. Blood
Brothers may play cards requiring basic Potence as a vampire with a
capacity of 3. Any cost in blood is paid with life. If a card would
give them blood, give them life instead. Burn this card at the end of
combat or if the combat is canceled.

Conscripted Statue
Action Modifier
Visceratika
Only usable when an action is blocked.
The opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution each round
of the resulting combat when the range is close. Cancel the resulting
combat and put this card into play. This card represents an ally with
2 life and 2 strength. This ally enters combat with the blocking
minion. This ally gets an optional press during the combat. Burn this
card after combat or if the combat is canceled.

Freak Drive
Action Modifier
Fortitude
Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving the
action). This vampire untaps.
As above, but usable even if the action is blocked (play after combat,
if any).

Bioreset
